subject: Ciências
description_pt: Identificar as principais partes de uma planta (raiz, caule, folhas, flores e frutos) e a função desempenhada por cada uma delas, e analisar as relações entre as plantas, o ambiente e os demais seres vivos.

components.description_pt: Identificar estruturas das plantas como raízes, caules, folhas, flores e frutos e descrever seus papéis na sobrevivência
components.description_en: Identify plant structures such as roots, stems, leaves, flowers, and fruits and describe their roles in survival
components.cc_component_description: Identify plant structures such as roots, stems, leaves, flowers, and fruits and describe their roles in survival

components.description_pt: Descrever a função realizada por cada parte principal de uma planta
components.description_en: Describe the function performed by each main part of a plant
components.cc_component_description: Distinguish between components of a system and describe how each contributes to the whole

components.description_pt: Explicar relações entre plantas e outros organismos vivos ou fatores ambientais
components.description_en: Explain relationships between plants and other living organisms or environmental factors
components.cc_component_description: Explain how an organism's survival depends on interactions with both living organisms and nonliving environmental factors

cc_matches.description: All organisms have external parts. Different animals use their body parts in different ways to see, hear, grasp objects, protect themselves, move from place to place, and seek, find, and take in food, water and air. Plants also have different parts (roots, stems, leaves, flowers, fruits) that help them survive and grow.
Systems in the natural and designed world have parts that work together.
Organisms, and populations of organisms, are dependent on their environmental interactions both with other living things and with nonliving factors.
